description: This file defines the InstanceCreationController class within the OrangeHRM installer module. The controller manages the pre-render logic for the instance creation screen during the installation process, setting up the associated Vue component and updating the state container.

classes.name: InstanceCreationController
classes.description: Controller handling the pre-render setup for the instance creation step in the installer, extending AbstractInstallerVueController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the Vue component for the instance creation screen and updates the current installation screen state.
